claim: A native Qdrant full snapshot survived encrypted Restic backup/restore and a fresh native Qdrant restore, preserving five collections, 201 points, collection configuration and one exact query result.

retained_failures.cause: An explicit shared storage.temp_path collided during outer and nested config.json extraction.
retained_failures.resolution: Omit temp_path and use another fresh storage directory, as supported by pinned upstream source.

retained_failures.cause: Named-vector object supplied instead of dense numeric array.
retained_failures.resolution: Use dense numeric array plus using=dense according to the native query API.

commands: POST /collections/{name}/points/query with dense vector, using=dense, exact=true, limit=5
limitations: One same-host drill; repository and password share the host, with no independent key escrow or off-host durability proof.
Sequential cross-collection observations do not establish a globally atomic transaction; matching source before/after state bounds this observation.
One exact-query equivalence check is not a semantic retrieval benchmark or SocratiCode MCP rebinding test.
No automatic schedule, retention deletion, model inference, broker action or provider token savings.
The native API was exercised; optional static dashboard assets were absent. Raw snapshots and private query payloads are not published.
